tei:div.tei:p: gter mdzod/ (wa)pa la/ zhig gling tshe sgrub rgyal ba 'dus pa'i las byang ldeb/ 12 1-23 dbang chog ldeb/ 15 25-54 grol thig tshe sgrub sku gsum 'dus pa sgrub thabs dbang chog dang bcas pa ldeb/ 20 55-93 a haṃ dwangs ma gsum ldan ldeb/ 2 95-97 'ja' tshon tshe sgrub gnam lcags rdo rje'i las byang ldeb/ 13 99-124 skong ba ldeb/ 4 125-132 'chi bdag gtor chen ldeb/ 16 133-163 glud rabs ldeb/ 5 165-174 dbang chog ldeb/ 19 175-211 bdud 'dul tshe sgrub tsha ba dmar thag las byang ldeb/ 7 213-225 tshe 'gugs ldeb/ 2 227-230 dbang chog ldeb/ 13 231-256 smin gling tshe sgrub 'chi med yang snying kun 'dus gter gzhung ldeb/ 6 257-247 brgyud 'debs dang las bum sgrub thabs bcas ldeb/ 1 249-250 las byang ldeb/ 8 251-265 rjes chog ldeb/ 2 267-269 rgyun khyer ldeb/ 1 271-272 brtan bzhugs ldeb/ 4 273-280 dbang chog ldeb/ 4 281-288 mtshams sbyor ldeb/ 7 289-302 bsnyen yig ldeb/ 5 303-312 gar dbang rdo rje'i tshe sgrub ye shes rgya mdud las byang dbang chog dang bcas la ldeb/ 13 313-337 klong gsal yang gsang bla med gsol 'debs ldeb/ 1 339-340 byin 'beb ldeb/ 1 341-342 las byang dang de'i mthar tshogs mchod spyi 'gro zab rgyas shig kyang yod pa bcas la ldeb/ 12 343-366 tshe 'gugs rgyas pa dang bsdus pa bcas la ldeb/ 4 367-373 dbang chog mtshams sbyor ldeb/ 5 375-383 yon dge'i nam snying tshe sgrub ldeb/ 5 385-393 dbang chog rje pad+ma'i gsung ldeb/ 5 395-403 stag sham tshe sgrub gsang dril zung 'jug yang snying bcud bsdus kyi las byang ldeb/ 10 405-424 dbang chog ldeb/ 9 425-442 dbon gsas khyung thogs kyi tshe sgrub ye shes srog tig gter gzhung ldeb/ 4 443-450 dbang chog ldeb/ 5 451-460 bde gling rdo rje rgya mdud brgyud 'debs ldeb/ 2 461-464 las byang ldeb/ 10 465-484 khrid yig ldeb/ 7 485-498

dbang chog ldeb/ 11 499-520 rol rdor lcags kyi bang mdzod las byang gter gzhung ldeb/ 12 521-544 dbang chog ldeb/ 9 545-562 rog rje gling pa'i tshe sgrub gsang ba rmad byung gter gzhung ldeb/ 4 563-570 dbang chog ldeb/ 6 571-581 chos gling gnyis pa gar dbang 'chi med rdo rje'i tshe sgrub 'chi med thugs tig gi brgyud 'debs ldeb/ 1 583-584 las byang ldeb/ 15 585-614 dzap bskul ldeb/ 1 615 tshe 'gugs ldeb/ 7 617-630 don dbang ldeb/ 6 631-642 theg gling rgyal sras zla ba'i 'od zer tshe sgrub rdo rje snying po 'od kyi drwa ba'i las byang ldeb/ 11 643-664 dbang chog ldeb/ 8 665-679 dpa' bo brgyad pa'i dgongs gter tshe sgrub skor la/ brgyud 'debs ldeb/ 1 681 gter gzhung las byang sogs dang gsang sgrub zin bris dngos slob pad sprul gsung bcas la ldeb/ 15 683-712 bsnyen yig gsar bris ldeb/ 6 713-724 mchog gling zab bdun tshe dkar brgyud 'debs ldeb/ 1 725-726 mtshams sbyor ldeb/ 1 727-728 las byang ldeb/ 17 729-761 sman mchod ldeb/ 1 763 tshe 'gugs ldeb/ 6 765-775 phrin las bsdus pa ldeb/ 7 777-789 dbang chog ldeb/ 19 791-828 mchog gling thugs sgrub chos sku tshe dpag med kyi las byang dbang chog dang bcas pa ldeb/ 19 829-866 bsnyen sgrub zin bris ldeb/ 2 867-870 bla bslu'i cho ga ldeb/ 12 871-893 de'i 'gres byang ldeb/ 1 895 bcas bzhugs//
